correctness.rationale: On the repaired statement: the multipartite Laplacian splits orthogonally into the constant, between-part and within-part spaces with eigenvalues 0, N and N−m. Substituting the projectors gives the diagonal spectral measure and both off-diagonal formulas. The exact derivative numerators establish strict decrease of R and g on [0,∞), yielding strictly positive off-diagonals at h>0 and strictly decreasing diagonals. At fixed h>0 each smaller-part measure has larger upper tails (including the case m=1), giving strict smallest-part ordering; the limit 2/N−1 proves the single crossing for N≥3. For N=2 the diagonal is (1+R(2h))/2>0. The same-order example was independently recomputed exactly: −66473/957799 and 1999/166291. Symmetry and the action on the constant vector give both unit sums; eigenvalues of modulus at most one, including 1, give norm one. The frozen Finding incorrectly called matrices with negative diagonal doubly stochastic; the replacement explicitly restricts this to the nonnegative interval, and the verifier's output now describes what its assertions check.
residual_risks: Finite checks do not prove the all-partition result; the spectral and scalar arguments do. No internal-stage, nonlinear, weighted or directed claim is audited.

value.rationale: An all-size entrywise positivity boundary is structurally useful for choosing completed diffusion steps and separates norm stability from signs. It identifies the first lost signs and reduces a partition-dependent matrix check to one scalar root; the six-vertex comparison shows why order alone is insufficient.
residual_risks: The threshold is not a numerical error bound or a claim about intermediate stages.
